title: I stopped remembering my dreams..
content: After a period of dreams where I kept telling the people in my NEXT dream about the previous dream I had. So these dreams would be back to back in the same night. This happened a few times back to back, and ever since I haven’t really been remembering any dreams. When I told the dream people about the dream I had, they didn’t give much of a reaction. Also, I don’t think these dreams were inside my dreamscape/mall world. They felt more like random, meaningless dreams. However, there was one dreamscape dream where I did go around screaming at all the dream people that we were in a dream. I remember thinking they’d be upset at me. I usually remember I’m dreaming whenever something bad happens, and then I wake up. My inability to remember my dreams probably is because I started smoking weed more, but then again my dreams stopped before I started smoking more again. My theory is that my dreamscape privileges and dream access in general has been temporarily revoked because I kept breaking the 4th wall in my dreams. Or maybe I’ve made my dreams too confusing for my brain to remember now, overcomplicated what was already a tricky thing to understand. Or…I could be having only nightmares. Since I’m often aware when I’m having nightmares, maybe I could be stopping the dreams before they even start? Have you done anything inside your dreams that triggered a time where you couldn’t remember your dreams anymore?
